stemMarkdown: Walking at 9 km/h a student reaches school 25 minutes late, and walking at 13 km/h he reaches 18 minutes early. Find the distance (in km) to the school. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The two journeys differ in time by $25 + 18 = 43$ minutes $= 0.7167$ hours. If the distance is $d$, then $\dfrac{d}{9} - \dfrac{d}{13} = 0.7167$, giving $d = 20.9625$ km.
